Step 3. By the metric spectral theorem, we decompose \(T_{01320013} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the metric spectral family.

Conclusion. The result follows by combining Steps 1-3 through Fourier approximation and the compactness of the spectral family.
